pages.title: Hangars
pages.text: Create: Hangars scatters small aircraft sheds across the Overworld. Their chests hold starter Aeronautics parts, so a first ship does not have to start from scratch.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Hangars come in eight biome styles: plains, birch, taiga, dark oak, cherry, jungle, bamboo and savanna. Jungle and plains versions are the most common. They are spaced roughly **500 blocks** apart.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text:
Two kinds of chest:

- **Shelf chests**: Hot Air Burners, Hot Air Envelopes, Propellers, Windmill Sails, Symmetric Sails, Springs, Redstone Magnets and basic Create gear.
- **Pulley chests**: Rope Couplings and [Andesite Casing](item://create:andesite_casing).

pages.title: Hot Air Burner
pages.text: A common find on hangar shelves, along with envelopes and [#](2E5AAC)[propellers](entry://flight/propellers)[#]().

pages.title: Rope Coupling
pages.text: Found in pulley chests. Links a Rope Winch to a Rope Connector.
